description: Athletics age groups of World Athletics (U18, U20, Senior, Master) with their reference-date rule, and the O2SN 2026 eligibility groups (birth date limit, grades) for SD/MI, SMP/MTs and SMA/MA/SMK/MAK; championships keep their own reference rule.
status: ready for World Athletics rules and O2SN 2026; PASI U14/U16 and POPDA/POPNAS pending brief R-10b
source: World Athletics Book C C1.1/C2.1 Competition & Technical Rules (amendments effective up to 2026-03-20, PDF 2026-07-17); IAAF Scoring Tables for Combined Events (2016); Puspresnas O2SN 2026 guides SD/MI, SMP/MTs, SMA/MA/SMK/MAK (March 2026) and the O2SN scoring tables they link to (Trilomba SMP, Pancalomba SMA/SMK; fetched 2026-11-26). Raw PDFs and SOURCE.txt in sources/atletik/ and sources/atletik/o2sn/
licence: Copyright World Athletics (rules, tables) and Kemendikdasmen (O2SN guides); facts with references used under decision F-027
procedure: Transcribed by hand into tools/converters/atletik.py, which checks the scoring parameters against printed table rows (with --tables: every row of the two O2SN tables, 17,595 rows) and the tables for completeness, then writes the three sets. Version 2026-11-26 is the date the O2SN scoring tables were fetched, the newest source.
